    Type Alias SignedArcId

    SignedArcId: number

    Mapshaper feature shape vocabulary.

    Path features (polygon / polyline):

    • SignedArcId: a signed arc id; negative values encode reversed direction. Use arcId >= 0 ? arcId : ~arcId for the absolute id.
    • PathPart: list of signed arc ids that traverse one ring or polyline stroke.
    • PathShape: list of parts. Polygons use multiple parts for rings (outer + holes); polylines use multiple parts for multipart features.

    Point features:

    • Coord2: a single [x, y] pair. Mutable so in-place edits can write back through the same array.
    • PointShape: list of points (multi-point features). Some legacy mapshaper datasets store a single bare [x, y] instead of [[x, y]]; prefer normalizePointShape from source/layer-utils to coerce.

    null is reserved for deleted-but-still-indexed features (mapshaper keeps positional alignment between shapes and data.records).
